author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Rejected drawing had a boxed crown-like flame, an elliptical dish and a stick handle; redrawn from the reference: three-tongued flame (tall middle tongue leaning right) rising from the rim, trapezoid bowl with rounded base, pointed cone handle. Checked 48px light/dark.
omissions: Small gap between flame and rim closed so the flame rises from the rim; handle tip pointed instead of rounded.
